summary.text: Shiloh Salazar is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 72.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom, advocate, small business owner and lifelong West Texan.

paragraphs.text: Salazar said she is a former educator and the parent of a child with special needs, and that she has spent years organizing and advocating on public schools, early childhood programs, water security, agriculture and healthcare access.
She also said she previously ran for county commissioner.
Salazar named public education and early childhood systems, rural and working-family healthcare, and support for workers, families and rural infrastructure as her key campaign messages.
She said she supports expanding Medicaid coverage, paid family and medical leave, and opposes policies that divert public dollars away from neighborhood schools.
